defaults.summary: PostgreSQL, one database and role per group.

runtime.initialise:
set -e
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The existing PostgreSQL cluster uses an unsupported data layout; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" | "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/initdb" --pgdata="$STACK_DATA_DIR/pgdata" --username=stack_admin --auth=scram-sha-256 --pwfile=/dev/stdin --encoding=UTF8 --no-sync

runtime.group_rename:
set -e
PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql" -h "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR" -p "$STACK_PORT" -U stack_admin -d postgres -X -w -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v ECHO=none <<'SQL'
SET log_statement = 'none';
\getenv old_group STACK_OLD_GROUP
\getenv new_group STACK_GROUP
SELECT format('ALTER DATABASE %I RENAME TO %I', :'old_group', :'new_group')
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = :'old_group')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = :'new_group')\gexec
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I RENAME TO %I', :'old_group', :'new_group')
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'old_group')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'new_group')\gexec
SQL
runtime.database_rename:
set -e
PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql" -h "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR" -p "$STACK_PORT" -U stack_admin -d postgres -X -w -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v ECHO=none <<'SQL'
SET log_statement = 'none';
\getenv old_user STACK_OLD_DATABASE_USER
\getenv new_user STACK_DATABASE_USER
SELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I RENAME TO %I', :'old_user', :'new_user')
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'old_user')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'new_user')\gexec
SELECT format('COMMENT ON ROLE %I IS %L', :'new_user', 'stack:database:' || :'new_user')
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = :'new_user')\gexec
SQL

windows.initialise:
set -e
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The existing PostgreSQL cluster uses an unsupported data layout; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
password_file="$STACK_DATA_DIR/initdb-password"
trap 'rm -f "$password_file"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$password_file"
"$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/initdb.exe" --pgdata="$STACK_DATA_DIR/pgdata" --username=stack_admin --auth=scram-sha-256 --pwfile="$password_file" --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C --no-sync

runtime.database_drop:
set -e
PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/psql" -h "$STACK_SOCKET_DIR" -p "$STACK_PORT" -U stack_admin -X -w -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v ECHO=none -d postgres <<'SQL'
{snippet:target-owned}
SELECT format('DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS %I WITH (FORCE)', :'database_name')\gexec
SQL

recipes.title: Laravel with PostgreSQL, Valkey and S3
recipes.gives: Gives the site DATABASE_URL, the DB_* variables and DB_CONNECTION=pgsql; the REDIS_* variables; the AWS_* and S3_* variables, AWS_BUCKET=b.shop.uploads among them; and APP_URL. Service-prefixed copies such as DB_DATABASE_URL and CACHE_REDIS_URL come too, and psql joins the shell.

recipes.title: Several databases on one server
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
services:
  - name: db
    type: postgres
    databases:
      - {name: app, env_prefix: ""}
      - {name: wallet, env_prefix: WALLET}
recipes.gives: Gives DATABASE_URL and the DB_* variables for app, and the same names prefixed WALLET_ for wallet, such as WALLET_DATABASE_URL; each database has its own role.

recipes.title: One server shared by several groups
recipes.gives: Gives shop DATABASE_URL and the DB_* variables, served by one PostgreSQL process for every group naming shared: local; no group can open another's database.
